title: Yes, No, and a Tone That Moves
label: ch:zh-shi
canDo: I can write 是 by finishing 日 before the body underneath, answer a yes-or-no question either way by keeping or negating the word I was asked about, and apply the rule that 不 rises before a falling tone even though the writing never shows it.

payoff.summary: The first exchange in which the reader can answer either way -- 是 for yes, 不是 for no -- and hear the negator's pitch rise on a page that records no such thing.
